text:
Predicates:
Winner(x, y) ::: x is the winner of y.
Participated(x, y) ::: x participated in y.
SixWayTie(y) ::: y is a six-way tie on the leaderboard.
FromBelgium(x) ::: x is from Belgium.
OnLeaderboard(x, y) ::: x is on the leaderboard of y.
Year(y) ::: y is a year.

Premises:
Winner(steinhauer, duMaurier1992) ::: Steinhauer was the winner of the 1992 du Maurier Classic.
Participated(steinhauer, duMaurier1992) ::: Steinhauer participated in the 1992 du Maurier Classic.
SixWayTie(leaderboard) ::: There was one six-way tie on the leaderboard.
∃x (FromBelgium(x) ∧ OnLeaderboard(x, duMaurier1992) ∧ x ≠ steinhauer) ::: One person in the six-way tie was from Belgium, and this person is Decampe.
FromBelgium(descampe) ::: Descampe is from Belgium.
∀x (OnLeaderboard(x, duMaurier1992) → Participated(x, duMaurier1992)) ::: All people on the leaderboard participated in the 1992 du Maurier Classic.

Conclusion:
¬Winner(steinhauer, duMaurier1992) ::: Steinhauer was not the winner of the 1992 du Maurier Classic.
